notes.title: Ascension To The Throne is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Ascension To The Throne is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Ascension to the Throne Updated
notes.content:

- Game updated to the latest version 1.128
- Resource files repacked to decrease installation size by 1 Gb
- Stuttering in video cutscenes fixed

- Ресурсы переупакованы для сокращения занимаемого места на диске
- Устранено "заикание" в видео заставках

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Ascension to the Throne, 20% off!
notes.content:
Ascension to the Throne is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Ascension to the Throne is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements. In a world of fantasy the hero will have to pass many tests on his way to victory. Enemies seek to stop players from regaining power and taking revenge. Gain new friends to aid you in reclaiming the throne. Become the King you were born to be - wise, brave and courageous.

*Offer ends April 30 at 10AM Pacific Time
